decisions.reason: As a very new product with only a website mention, its performance is still uncertain, but an established medium-sized machinery firm would usually tolerate some short-run ambiguity and keep it while learning unless results clearly fall below aspiration levels.

Because it had its own product page at launch and appears close to the firm’s core machinery capabilities, management would likely see enough initial commitment and fit to keep it on the market while monitoring early sales against aspirations.

Although the limited website prominence suggests more cautious support, it is still a fresh launch in a related equipment category, so boundedly rational management would likely continue it for another period before reallocating resources.

Its dedicated page indicates strategic attention, and an older medium-sized German manufacturer would typically use available organisational slack to keep such a new offering on the market until clearer evidence shows a sustained shortfall versus aspirations.
